title: A request the mock rejects is logged at warn while the test runs, naming the interaction, the variant and the mismatch, against the real engine.
why: behavioural spec 'execute': while each closure runs, the SDK drains the session's stream and hands each 'consumer-session/exchange' event to its language's logging, a 'mismatched' one at warn, naming the interaction as '<description>' [<variant>] and each mismatch's path and message (engine-protocol spec §9.6, staged plan S3.5).
note: The logging is each language's own, which data cannot run, so each language has a subject (ADR 0076 decision 5). The client asks for the wrong order and ignores the rejection, so the engine's verdict fails the variant.

engine-log: 'get an order' [base]: the request did not match
